lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਖੁ ਮੇਰੇ ਗੁਸਈਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raam mai moorakh har raakh mere gusaeeaa ||
lines.translation: O my Lord, I am so foolish; save me, O my Lord God!

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਕੀ ਉਪਮਾ ਤੁਝਹਿ ਵਡਈਆ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: jan kee upamaa tujhahi vadaeeaa ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Your servant's praise is Your Own Glorious Greatness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੰਦਰਿ ਘਰਿ ਆਨੰਦੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਮਨਿ ਭਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: ma(n)dar ghar aana(n)d har har jas man bhaavai ||
lines.translation: Those whose minds are pleased by the Praises of the Lord, Har, Har, are joyful in the palaces of their own homes.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸਭ ਰਸ ਮੀਠੇ ਮੁਖਿ ਲਗਹਿ ਜਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: sabh ras meethe mukh lagahi jaa har gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: Their mouths savor all the sweet delicacies when they sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਪਰਵਾਰੁ ਸਧਾਰੁ ਹੈ ਇਕੀਹ ਕੁਲੀ ਸਭੁ ਜਗਤੁ ਛਡਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: har jan paravaar sadhaar hai ikeeh kulee sabh jagat chhadaavai ||2||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servants are the saviors of their families; they save their families for twenty-one generations - they save the entire world! ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕੀਆ ਸੋ ਹਰਿ ਕੀਆ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh keeaa so har keeaa har kee vadiaaee ||
lines.translation: Whatever has been done, has been done by the Lord; it is the Glorious Greatness of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜੀਅ ਤੇਰੇ ਤੂੰ ਵਰਤਦਾ ਹਰਿ ਪੂਜ ਕਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jee tere too(n) varatadaa har pooj karaaee ||
lines.translation: O Lord, in Your creatures, You are pervading; You inspire them to worship You.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਭਗਤਿ ਭੰਡਾਰ ਲਹਾਇਦਾ ਆਪੇ ਵਰਤਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: har bhagat bha(n)daar lahaaidaa aape varataaee ||3||
lines.translation: The Lord leads us to the treasure of devotional worship; He Himself bestows it. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲਾਲਾ ਹਾਟਿ ਵਿਹਾਝਿਆ ਕਿਆ ਤਿਸੁ ਚਤੁਰਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: laalaa haat vihaajhiaa kiaa tis chaturaaee ||
lines.translation: I am a slave, purchased in Your market; what clever tricks do I have?

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਰਾਜਿ ਬਹਾਲੇ ਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਲਾਮੁ ਘਾਸੀ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਕਢਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: je raaj bahaale taa har gulaam ghaasee kau har naam kadhaaee ||
lines.translation: If the Lord were to set me upon a throne, I would still be His slave. If I were a grass-cutter, I would still chant the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨੁ ਨਾਨਕੁ ਹਰਿ ਕਾ ਦਾਸੁ ਹੈ ਹਰਿ ਕੀ ਵਡਿਆਈ ॥੪॥੨॥੮॥੪੬॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak har kaa daas hai har kee vadiaaee ||4||2||8||46||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak is the slave of the Lord; contemplate the Glorious Greatness of the Lord||4||2||8||46||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਗੁਆਰੇਰੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee guaareree mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਕਿਰਸਾਣੀ ਕਿਰਸਾਣੁ ਕਰੇ ਲੋਚੈ ਜੀਉ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: kirasaanee kirasaan kare lochai jeeu laai ||
lines.translation: The farmers love to work their farms;

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਲੁ ਜੋਤੈ ਉਦਮੁ ਕਰੇ ਮੇਰਾ ਪੁਤੁ ਧੀ ਖਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: hal jotai udam kare meraa put dhee khaai ||
lines.translation: they plow and work the fields, so that their sons and daughters may eat.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਪੁ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਅੰਤਿ ਛਡਾਇ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: tiu har jan har har jap kare har a(n)t chhadaai ||1||
lines.translation: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and in the end, the Lord shall save them. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੈ ਮੂਰਖ ਕੀ ਗਤਿ ਕੀਜੈ ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: mai moorakh kee gat keejai mere raam ||
lines.translation: I am foolish - save me, O my Lord!

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਸੇਵਾ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇ ਹਮ ਕਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: gur satigur sevaa har laai ham kaam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: O Lord, enjoin me to work and serve the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਲੈ ਤੁਰੇ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੀ ਸਉਦਾਗਰੁ ਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: lai ture saudaagaree saudaagar dhaavai ||
lines.translation: The traders buy horses, planning to trade them.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਖਟੈ ਆਸਾ ਕਰੈ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹੁ ਵਧਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: dhan khatai aasaa karai maaiaa mohu vadhaavai ||
lines.translation: They hope to earn wealth; their attachment to Maya increases.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਤਾ ਹਰਿ ਬੋਲਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਵੈ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: tiu har jan har har bolataa har bol sukh paavai ||2||
lines.translation: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har; chanting the Lord's Name, they find peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬਿਖੁ ਸੰਚੈ ਹਟਵਾਣੀਆ ਬਹਿ ਹਾਟਿ ਕਮਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: bikh sa(n)chai hatavaaneeaa bahi haat kamaai ||
lines.translation: The shop-keepers collect poison, sitting in their shops, carrying on their business.

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੋਹ ਝੂਠੁ ਪਸਾਰਾ ਝੂਠ ਕਾ ਝੂਠੇ ਲਪਟਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: moh jhooth pasaaraa jhooth kaa jhoothe lapataai ||
lines.translation: Their love is false, their displays are false, and they are engrossed in falsehood.

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਉ ਹਰਿ ਜਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਧਨੁ ਸੰਚਿਆ ਹਰਿ ਖਰਚੁ ਲੈ ਜਾਇ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: tiu har jan har dhan sa(n)chiaa har kharach lai jaai ||3||
lines.translation: In just the same way, the Lord's humble servants gather the wealth of the Lord's Name; they take the Lord's Name as their supplies. ||3||

lines.gurmukhi: ਇਹੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਮੋਹ ਕੁਟੰਬੁ ਹੈ ਭਾਇ ਦੂਜੈ ਫਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: ihu maaiaa moh kuta(n)b hai bhaai doojai phaas ||
lines.translation: This emotional attachment to Maya and family, and the love of duality, is a noose around the neck.

lines.gurmukhi: ਗੁਰਮਤੀ ਸੋ ਜਨੁ ਤਰੈ ਜੋ ਦਾਸਨਿ ਦਾਸ ॥
lines.transliteration: guramatee so jan tarai jo daasan daas ||
lines.translation: Following the Guru's Teachings, the humble servants are carried across; they become the slaves of the Lord's slaves.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨਿ ਨਾਨਕਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਧਿਆਇਆ ਗੁਰਮੁਖਿ ਪਰਗਾਸ ॥੪॥੩॥੯॥੪੭॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak naam dhiaaiaa guramukh paragaas ||4||3||9||47||
lines.translation: Servant Nanak meditates on the Naam; the Gurmukh is enlightened. ||4||3||9||47||

lines.gurmukhi: ਗਉੜੀ ਬੈਰਾਗਣਿ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: gauRee bairaagan mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Gauree Bairaagan, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਦਿਨਸੁ ਰਾਤਿ ਲਾਲਚੁ ਕਰੇ ਭਰਮੈ ਭਰਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit dinas raat laalach kare bharamai bharamaaiaa ||
lines.translation: Continuously, day and night, they are gripped by greed and deluded by doubt.

lines.gurmukhi: ਵੇਗਾਰਿ ਫਿਰੈ ਵੇਗਾਰੀਆ ਸਿਰਿ ਭਾਰੁ ਉਠਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: vegaar phirai vegaareeaa sir bhaar uthaaiaa ||
lines.translation: The slaves labor in slavery, carrying the loads upon their heads.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਰ ਕੀ ਜਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਕਰੇ ਸੋ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਹਰਿ ਲਾਇਆ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: jo gur kee jan sevaa kare so ghar kai ka(n)m har laaiaa ||1||
lines.translation: That humble being who serves the Guru is put to work by the Lord in His Home. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਮੇਰੇ ਰਾਮ ਤੋੜਿ ਬੰਧਨ ਮਾਇਆ ਘਰ ਕੈ ਕੰਮਿ ਲਾਇ ॥
lines.transliteration: mere raam toR ba(n)dhan maaiaa ghar kai ka(n)m laai ||
lines.translation: O my Lord, please break these bonds of Maya, and put me to work in Your Home.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਹਰਿ ਗੁਣ ਗਾਵਹ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮਿ ਸਮਾਇ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit har gun gaavah har naam samaai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: I continuously sing the Glorious Praises of the Lord; I am absorbed in the Lord's Name. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਰੁ ਪ੍ਰਾਣੀ ਚਾਕਰੀ ਕਰੇ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਰਾਜੇ ਅਰਥਿ ਸਭ ਮਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: nar praanee chaakaree kare narapat raaje arath sabh maaiaa ||
lines.translation: Mortal men work for kings, all for the sake of wealth and Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਕੈ ਬੰਧੈ ਕੈ ਡਾਨਿ ਲੇਇ ਕੈ ਨਰਪਤਿ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਇਆ ॥
lines.transliteration: kai ba(n)dhai kai daan lei kai narapat mar jaaiaa ||
lines.translation: But the king either imprisons them, or fines them, or else dies himself.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧੰਨੁ ਧਨੁ ਸੇਵਾ ਸਫਲ ਸਤਿਗੁਰੂ ਕੀ ਜਿਤੁ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਜਪਿ ਹਰਿ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਇਆ ॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: dha(n)n dhan sevaa saphal satiguroo kee jit har har naam jap har sukh paaiaa ||2||
lines.translation: Blessed, rewarding and fruitful is the service of the True Guru; through it, I chant the Name of the Lord, Har, Har, and I have found peace. ||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਿਤ ਸਉਦਾ ਸੂਦੁ ਕੀਚੈ ਬਹੁ ਭਾਤਿ ਕਰਿ ਮਾਇਆ ਕੈ ਤਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: nit saudaa sood keechai bahu bhaat kar maaiaa kai taaee ||
lines.translation: Everyday, people carry on their business, with all sorts of devices to earn interest, for the sake of Maya.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਾ ਲਾਹਾ ਦੇਇ ਤਾ ਸੁਖੁ ਮਨੇ ਤੋਟੈ ਮਰਿ ਜਾਈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jaa laahaa dei taa sukh mane totai mar jaaee ||
lines.translation: If they earn a profit, they are pleased, but their hearts are broken by losses.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਗੁਣ ਸਾਝੀ ਗੁਰ ਸਿਉ ਕਰੇ ਨਿਤ ਨਿਤ ਸੁਖੁ ਪਾਈ ॥੩॥
lines.transliteration: jo gun saajhee gur siu kare nit nit sukh paaee ||3||
lines.translation: One who is worthy, becomes a partner with the Guru, and finds a lasting peace forever. ||3||
